cards.title: display: flex
cards.body: Boxes normally stack on top of each other. Give the box that holds them `display: flex` and they line up in a row.
cards.code:
One
Two
Three

hi.title: display: flex
hi.body: Boxes normally ek ke upar ek stack hote hain. Jo box unhe rakhta hai use `display: flex` do, toh woh ek row mein lag jaate hain.

cards.title: gap
cards.body: `gap` adds space between the boxes in a flex row.
cards.code:
One
Two
Three

hi.title: gap
hi.body: `gap` flex row ke boxes ke beech jagah jodta hai.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: The boxes should sit side by side, but they still stack. Tap the bug.

bug.fix: `display: flex` goes on the box that holds them, `.row`, not on each box inside it.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Boxes ko agal bagal hona chahiye, par woh abhi bhi stack hote hain. Bug par tap karo.
hi.fix: `display: flex` us box par jaata hai jo unhe rakhta hai, `.row` par, uske andar ke har box par nahi.

check.question: Where does `display: flex` go to line up three boxes in a row?
options: On the box that holds them
On each of the three boxes
check.explanation: Flexbox is set on the parent. Its children then line up.

hi.question: Teen boxes ko ek row mein lagane ke liye `display: flex` kahan jaata hai?
options: Us box par jo unhe rakhta hai
Teeno boxes mein se har ek par
hi.explanation: Flexbox parent par set hota hai. Phir uske children line mein lag jaate hain.

exercise.prompt: Put the three `.item` boxes in a row: give `.row` `display: flex` and a `gap` of `16px`.
exercise.promptHi: Teen `.item` boxes ko ek row mein lagao: `.row` ko `display: flex` aur `16px` ka `gap` do.

checks.label: `.row` still holds three `.item` boxes
checks.labelHi: `.row` mein abhi bhi teen `.item` boxes hain
